agents.title: Guardrails
agents.description: Encode your coding, security, and architecture standards once, so every downstream agent inherits them.

agents.title: Domain Analyzer
agents.description: Infer the project's business domain from its code and docs, then propose opt-in candidate guardrails for SME review.

agents.title: FDA 21 CFR Part 11 & IEC 62304
agents.description: Check electronic-records and e-signature integrity plus medical-device lifecycle rigor, mapped to software safety class.

agents.title: ISO 27001 / 27701
agents.description: Audit ISMS and privacy-management controls against Annex A, reusing shared evidence across SOC 2, ISO, and HIPAA.

agents.title: Requirements Analyst
agents.description: Turn a BRD or product brief into structured user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria.

agents.title: BRD Generator
agents.description: Turn a raw business requirement, typed or in a document, into a structured, specify-ready BRD.

agents.title: Clarifier
agents.description: Interrogate vague or missing requirements up front, before they turn into expensive rework.

agents.title: Requirements Quality
agents.description: Score the spec for completeness, clarity, and consistency — effectively unit tests for your requirements.

agents.title: GDPR Compliance
agents.description: Verify data-subject rights, lawful basis, minimization, retention, and transfers, and scaffold Article 30 records.

agents.title: Canadian Privacy — PIPEDA / PHIPA / Law 25
agents.description: Evaluate PIPEDA's fair-information principles and Quebec Law 25's mandatory PIAs and privacy-by-default duties.

agents.title: EU AI Act & Responsible-AI Governance
agents.description: Classify AI components by risk tier and assemble the transparency and Annex IV documentation the EU AI Act requires.

agents.title: Legal-Obligation Extraction
agents.description: Turn regulatory and contractual text into testable acceptance criteria the compliance agents can consume.

agents.title: Architecture Planner
agents.description: Produce the technical plan and tech-stack decisions, choosing the design patterns that fit the problem.

agents.title: Architecture Decision Records (ADR)
agents.description: Capture a context-aware Architecture Decision Record grounded in the codebase, prior ADRs, and the constitution.

agents.title: Architecture Reviewer
agents.description: Audit the design against best practices, design principles, and your own standards before a line is written.

agents.title: HIPAA Compliance
agents.description: Audit PHI handling against the Security Rule technical safeguards and map gaps to §164.312.

agents.title: PCI-DSS
agents.description: Scope the cardholder-data environment and check development, storage, crypto, and testing controls against v4.0.1.

agents.title: Threat Modeling
agents.description: Generate design-time STRIDE and attack-surface analysis from data-flow and architecture.

agents.title: Performance & Scalability
agents.description: Static hot-path, complexity, and N+1 analysis with load-model sanity checks, surfacing risk before the build.

agents.title: Data Governance & Privacy Engineering
agents.description: Discover PII and PHI across code and schemas, map data flows and lineage, and classify data.

agents.title: API Design & Contract
agents.description: Lint OpenAPI specs, detect breaking changes, and enforce versioning and backward compatibility.

agents.title: Task Planner
agents.description: Break the plan into an ordered, dependency-aware task list, ready to sync straight to an issue tracker.

agents.title: Consistency
agents.description: Cross-check spec, plan, and tasks for drift, gaps, and contradictions before the build kicks off.

agents.title: Implementation
agents.description: Execute the task list in dependency order, building to spec with tests written alongside the code.

agents.title: Dependency & Supply-Chain
agents.description: Generate an SBOM and run reachability-aware vulnerability, license, and transitive supply-chain analysis.

agents.title: Database & Data-Layer
agents.description: Review schema design, migration safety, and indexing, flagging lock risk and backward-incompatible changes.

agents.title: Documentation Quality
agents.description: Assess API doc coverage, README and runbook completeness, and drift where the code changed but the docs did not.

agents.title: Technical-Debt & Maintainability
agents.description: Quantify complexity, duplication, dead code, and smells into a maintainability rating and remediation estimate.

agents.title: Testing
agents.description: Generate unit, integration, smoke, and end-to-end tests mapped to acceptance criteria — run inside the Implementation agent, not as a separate command.

agents.title: Test Coverage Analyst
agents.description: Find the gaps against the test pyramid, so coverage is real protection rather than just a percentage.

agents.title: Test Automation Analyst
agents.description: Recommend what is worth automating and where each test should run across the pipeline.

agents.title: Flaky Test Detector
agents.description: Find the tests that pass and fail on the same code, then fix the ones you approve, one at a time.

agents.title: Security Analyst
agents.description: Surface threat exposure and OWASP-class issues through static and dynamic analysis of the change.

agents.title: Accessibility & WCAG Compliance
agents.description: Audit the UI against WCAG 2.2 AA, map conformance to ADA, Section 508, and EN 301 549, then scaffold a VPAT.

agents.title: Carbon & Green-Software
agents.description: Estimate software carbon intensity with the ISO-standard SCI methodology and surface the efficiency hotspots.

agents.title: Internationalization Readiness
agents.description: Flag hardcoded strings, locale and RTL handling, and un-externalized resources before localization begins.

agents.title: Responsible-AI & Bias
agents.description: Audit ML components for bias, fairness, and explainability, and scaffold the model card.

agents.title: Create PR
agents.description: Open a correctly-targeted GitHub PR for the current spec branch and return its URL.

agents.title: Review PR
agents.description: Review a GitHub pull request against the spec, plan, tasks, ADRs, and constitution it carries, then publish a single human-curated review containing only the findings the reviewer selected.

agents.title: Operations Monitor
agents.description: Analyze logs, latency, and error signals post-deployment, surfacing anomalies and predicting SLA breaches.

agents.title: Incident Responder
agents.description: Correlate incident signals with recent deployments, recommend a targeted rollback or fix, and validate the resolution.

agents.title: SOC 2
agents.description: Map controls to the AICPA Trust Services Criteria and assemble continuous, change-managed evidence.

agents.title: SOX Change-Management
agents.description: Validate segregation of duties and change-approval evidence, producing an immutable release-approval trail.

agents.title: Infrastructure-as-Code Analysis
agents.description: Detect Terraform, CloudFormation, and Kubernetes misconfigurations and drift, mapped to CIS, PCI, and SOC 2.

agents.title: Cost & FinOps
agents.description: Estimate cloud cost from IaC, flag right-sizing and waste, and show the cost delta of each change.

agents.title: Observability Readiness
agents.description: Check whether logs, metrics, and traces are instrumented, SLOs defined, and alert coverage adequate.
